StoryMapJS
A month in the life of President Obama
September 2013: events taken from the WhiteHouse.gov site.
Sept 3
The President departs Joint Base Andrews.
Sept 4

The President arrives in Stockholm, Sweden. The President holds a bilateral meeting with Prime Minister Reinfeldt of Sweden. The President and Prime Minister Reinfeldt hold a press conference. The President tours an Energy Expo event. The President attends an official dinner with Nordic Leaders.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: President Obama and Prime Minister Reinfeldt of Sweden hold a joint press conference. September 4, 2013.

none: Sept 5: Part 1
The President meets with the King and Queen of Sweden.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: President Obama meets the King and Queen of Sweden

none: Sept 5: Part 2

The President arrives Saint Petersburg, Russia. The President holds a bilateral meeting with Prime Minister Abe of Japan. The President participates in an Official G-20 Arrival and Leaders Welcome. The President participates in G-20 Working Session One.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: President Obama arrives at G-20 dinner

none: Sept 6

The President holds a bilateral meeting with President Xi of China. The President participates in G-20 Working Session Two. The President holds a press conference. The President departs Saint Petersburg, Russia. The President arrives at the White House.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: President Obama holds a press conference at the G20 Summit in St. Petersburg, Russia. September 6, 2013.

none: Sept 9
The President receives the Presidential Daily Briefing. The President and the Vice President meet with Secretary of Defense Hagel.
Sept 10

The President and the Vice President receive the Presidential Daily Briefing. The President meets with the Senate Democratic Caucus. The President meets with the Senate Republican Conference. The President delivers a statement on Syria.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: President addresses the nation on Syria

none: Sept 11

The President, The Vice President, The First Lady, Dr. Jill Biden and White House staff observe a moment of silence to mark the 12th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks. The President participates in a service project. The President attends September 11th Observance Ceremony.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: Moment of silence at the White House

none: Sept 12

The President and the Vice President receive the Presidential Daily Briefing. The President holds a Cabinet meeting; the Vice President also attends. The President and the Vice President meet for lunch.
Sept 13

The President and the Vice President receive the Presidential Daily Briefing. The President holds a bilateral meeting with the Amir of Kuwait, His Highness Shaykh Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al Sabah and the Vice President attends. The President and the Vice President meet with Labor Leaders.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: President Obama and the Amir of Kuwait

none: Sept 16
The President receives the Presidential Daily Briefing. The President meets with senior advisors. The President delivers remarks to mark the five-year anniversary of the financial crisis.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: President Obama marks the anniversary of the financial crisis

none: Sept 17

The President and the Vice President receive the Presidential Daily Briefing. The President and the Vice President meet for lunch. The President participates in an Ambassador Credentialing Ceremony. The President and the Vice President meet with Secretary of Defense.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: President and Vice President having lunch

none: Sept 18

The President receives the Presidential Daily Briefing. The President delivers remarks to members of the Business Roundtable and answer questions. The President and the Vice President meet with Secretary of the Treasury Lew. The President and the Vice President meet with Secretary of State Kerry.

items.storymap:mediaCaption: President Obama Speaks to the Business Roundtable

none: Sept 19

The President and Vice President receive the Presidential Daily Briefing. The President delivers remarks at a meeting of his Export Council. The President meets with senior advisors. The President attends a DNC event.
Sept 20

The President departs Joint Base Andrews. The President arrives Kansas City, Missouri. The President delivers remarks at the Ford Stamping Plant. The President departs Kansas City, Missouri en route Washington, DC.
Sept 23

The President and First Lady depart Joint Base Andrews. The President and First Lady arrive New York City. The President holds a bilateral meeting with President Goodluck Jonathan of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. The President meets with USUN Mission employees and their families. The President and First Lady attend a reception for visiting Heads of State and Government.
Sept 24

The President addresses the United Nations General Assembly; the First Lady also attends. The President participates in a conversation with former President Clinton about the future of health care reform. The President and the First Lady depart New York en route Andrews Air Force Base.
Sept 25
The President holds a call with mayors, county officials, and state legislators on the Affordable Care Act. The President meets with Treasury Secretary Lew.
Sept 26
The President delivers remarks on the Affordable Care Act. The President attends a DNC event.
Sept 27
The President holds a bilateral meeting with Prime Minister Singh of India; the Vice President attends. The President delivers a statement
Sept 30

The President holds a bilateral meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu; the Vice President also attends. The President holds a working lunch with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu; the Vice President also attends. The President delivers a statement. The President holds a Cabinet Meeting; the Vice President also attends.
